snippet.title: CONTROL Resonant - Altered State Trailer | Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026
snippet.description:
Manhattan is overrun. Humanity's defenses have fallen. Dylan Faden is all we have left. But does someone who was once branded a monster really have what it takes to save us? 

In CONTROL Resonant, enter altered Manhattan. Take back the city. Take back control. Save your sister, regain your humanity. 

BUCKLE UP.

CONTROL Resonant arrives September 24th 2026 to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, and Mac via Steam and the App Store. Wishlist now. 

PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017682/  
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p092299fsgw 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669870/CONTROL_Resonant/ 
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/control-resonant-3568d3 

Developed and published by Remedy Entertainment.  

Find out more at https://controlgame.com/
